criterionOutcomes.criterion: The map layer selector includes Service as a selectable layer.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-1-types-before-service.png visibly lists Service; criterion-1-final.png shows Service selected in the Automobile dialog with Add layer available.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With Service unselected, the map displays no Service test-result points.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-2-map-service-unselected.png and criterion-2-final.png show the settled map with Automobile unselected and no Service result points on the displayed viewport.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When the user selects Service and matching authorised results are available, each matching result is displayed as a selectable map point.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-3-final.png shows Automobile - Service selected but no visible Service result points. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 prevents establishing matching authorised results; absence of points does not prove empty data or a defect.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When the user selects a Service result point and its details load successfully, a Service details dialog displays MSISDN, Test Time, Signal, Band, Service, Data Technology, PLMN and Serving Cell.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-4-final.png shows Service selected alongside Surveyor - Download, with a Surveyor cluster table rather than Service details. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks opening a Service result and checking the required fields.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With the Service details table displayed, sorting a supported column reorders the displayed rows according to that column.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-5-final.png shows a Surveyor cluster table, not the required Service details table. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks reaching Service details; Service-column sorting was not exercised.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: With the Service details table displayed, filtering a supported column limits the displayed rows to those matching the filter.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-6-final.png shows Service selected without a Service details table. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks reaching that table and exercising its column filters.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: When returned details include cell-neighbour data, the dialog displays each neighbour in its own labelled details table.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-7-final.png shows Automobile - HTTP Browsing alongside Service and an HTTP Browsing test-information panel, not Service neighbour details. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks inspecting returned Service neighbours and their labelled tables.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: While Service details are loading, the dialog displays a loading state.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-8-final.png shows an HTTP Browsing test-information panel, not a Service details loading state. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks initiating Service details retrieval; map-points loading cannot establish this criterion.

criterionOutcomes.criterion: If Service details cannot be retrieved, the dialog displays an error state and does not display stale details.
criterionOutcomes.reason: criterion-9-final.png shows HTTP Browsing details, not a Service retrieval-error state. The recorded Service points HTTP 500 blocks opening Service details and checking error/stale-data handling; unrelated HTTP details do not prove stale Service data.

reason: Service selection and the unselected map are directly evidenced. Recorded Service points HTTP 500 prevents establishing matching authorised results and reaching Service details; visible Surveyor/HTTP Browsing panels are unrelated.
